lessons.whatWasVerified: Cooperative Extension supports grooming as daily skin-care and bonding work plus the stated basic tool purposes. Missouri Extension supports solid-fixture, supervised quick-release tying; gentle rubber-curry/brush use; hoof-pick movement toward the toe; and professional veterinary/farrier escalation. lessons.lessonChangeMade: Removed unsupported treatment-outcome, circulation, universal outdoor-coat and diagnostic claims; replaced them with safe observation, individual care-plan, supervision and professional-escalation language. Removed the unsupported grass-kept knowledge check.
